title: Sharing Aggregated Patient Counts in Place of Line-Level EHR Data
summary: A Bayesian count-inference pipeline that reconstructs suppressed cells in aggregate 'cube' releases of categorical EHR data and evaluates the statistical fidelity, analytical utility, and privacy risk of that reconstruction against the original line-level data. SDV's CTGANSynthesizer is fit on the same data to produce a synthetic-data comparator used throughout the fidelity and utility evaluations.
evidence: README.md:69-73: SingleTableMetadata/CTGANSynthesizer fit and sampled to produce synthetic_df used as comparator in evaluate.py functions
